summary.name: Resumai
summary.one_liner: Resumai (resume AI) is a free AI resume builder that writes and tailors resume bullet points to job posts and checks them for applicant tracking system (ATS) compatibility.
use_cases: Tailoring a resume to a specific job post
Writing resume bullet points from rough notes
Checking a resume's ATS readability before applying
Generating a cover letter from a resume and job post
Practicing interview questions with an AI interviewer
Converting an old PDF or Word resume into a new template
summary.what_it_does: Resumai provides an AI resume writer that turns rough notes into bullet points and rewrites the professional summary in a chosen tone. It can tailor a resume to a pasted job post by adding keywords and reordering bullets, while stating that it only uses the user's real experience and that the user approves each change. A live ATS score and keyword-matching view show how applicant tracking systems read the resume as it is edited. Users can start from 18 listed ATS-friendly templates, import an existing PDF, Word file, or LinkedIn profile, and export to PDF or Word (.docx) without a watermark. The page also describes an AI job search, a cover letter generator, an AI interviewer, and an auto-apply feature for ATS portals such as Workday and Greenhouse.
notable: Live ATS score and keyword matching while editing
Connects to Claude or ChatGPT to edit resumes via chat
Auto-apply to Workday, Greenhouse, Ashby and other ATS portals
18 ATS-friendly templates and PDF/Word export with no watermark
caveats: Core resume building and export are free, but unlimited AI rewrites, tailoring for every application, cover letters, and interview practice require Resumai Pro (price not stated on page)
Only works with experience the user provides; it does not invent experience
Mobile apps are described for iOS and Android, but the page does not state full feature parity
